text:
Anya: Figma link with updated rollout panel -> https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/canary-preview (screenshots attached). Quick review please: canary CTA wording, version-history density, and rollback affordance. TL;DR: trying to avoid accidental rollbacks while keeping quick promotes easy.
Devon: skimming now. My top worry is users mixing 'Preview Canary' vs 'Start Canary' — the former sounds read-only.
Sandeep: agreed. 'Start Canary' feels actionable, but maybe 'Launch Canary (x% traffic)' is clearer.
Anya: good point. I pushed two variants: 1) "Start Canary" button with small secondary label "x% traffic · canary mode" 2) primary CTA "Launch (canary)" + inline traffic input. Which reads better?
Oliver: variant 2 is slightly better for power users. For keyboard users, the inline input must be focusable before confirm.
María: A11y nit — the visible label alone isn't enough. Need aria-describedby pointing to the traffic explanation, e.g., `aria-describedby="canary-help"`. Also ensure number input has step and aria-live for updates.
Kai: re: backend, we can accept both flows. But we should avoid free-form small inputs on the primary action — prefer a slider or stepper with preset ticks (1,5,10,20,50). That reduces accidental 0 or 100.
Devon: +1 to preset ticks. Also product asks for telemetry events: `canary.started`, `canary.updated`, `canary.promoted`, `rollback.initiated` — please standardize names.
Anya: noted. UX question: rollback CTA — do we show inline red 'Rollback' for each version row, or a more guarded modal via a 3-dot menu?
Sandeep: put rollback in the row menu. Inline red buttons are visually noisy and frightening. Use a contextual action menu + destructive button inside modal.
María: modal copy suggestion: Title: "Rollback deployment?" Body: "Rolling back will route traffic to version vX.Y.Z and may invalidate cached responses. This action is reversible but may take ~2 minutes." Confirm button: use `Rollback to vX.Y.Z` and mark it aria-destructive. Add keyboard shortcut hint on the modal.
Oliver: implementationally we'll need a clear primary/secondary order in modal: primary = Confirm rollback, secondary = Cancel. Also add an extra typed confirmation if the deployment has >50% traffic? Maybe require typing the version string for large rollbacks.
Devon: I like typed-confirm for >50% traffic. Let's default to simple confirm for <50%.
Kai: timeline density — the version history currently shows full hashes and long messages. Suggest collapsing long commit messages and showing a diff icon that opens a lightweight side pane. Keep rows compact to show more history.
Anya: I prototyped a compact mode toggle top-right of the timeline. Default to compact on small screens. Thoughts?
Sandeep: compact mode is great. But keep affordance for 'expand all' and per-row expand. Also accessibility: ensure the toggle has an accessible label `Toggle timeline density`.
María: color contrast: the current muted gray used for timestamps fails WCAG AA at small sizes. Use 4.5:1 contrast. Also the green/green-strong status chips need distinct textual labels, not only color (e.g., "Serving — 99%" plus icon).
Anya: got it — update colors and chips to include icons and hidden text for screen readers.
Devon: copy tweaks: instead of 'Promote' can we use 'Promote to stable' (explicit), and instead of 'Canary completed' use 'Canary finished — ready to promote'? More explicit.
Sandeep: agree, explicit verbs help. Also the metric snapshot in the rollout pane should show delta badges (▲/▼) with aria-live region that updates.
Oliver: small frontend note: when slider updates % we should debounce the API calls (250ms) and show a skeleton for metric previews while recalculating.
Kai: backend note: provide endpoint `POST /deployments/:id/canary` with body `{ percentage: 10, mode: "incremental" }`. We'll validate accepted ticks server-side.
RolloutBot: Canary started on deployment "payments-api" at 10% traffic by Anya — link: /deployments/payments-api/rollouts/12345 :rocket:
Devon: great test. Anya — can you update Figma with the final CTA copy and the compact toggle state? If possible, include the keyboard flows (tab order) as an appendix.
Anya: yes will update. I'll also add the modal copy variants and the typed-confirm rule. Expect an updated frame in ~2 hours.
María: I can run an a11y sweep once updated. Quick checklist I'll run: tab order, aria labels, contrast, live regions, and focus trap in modal.
Sandeep: thanks everyone. If no major objections by EOD we'll ship the copy + aria notes to eng as a follow-up PR. :thumbsup:
Oliver: ack, will scope the frontend tasks once Figma lands.
Devon: linking to related thread on rollout telemetry: #eng-platform for event naming sync.
Anya: thanks — filing a follow-up doc with final specs and images.
